title: Ukuthi i-HAX yakhula kanjani
peopleText: Wonke umuntu oke wanikela, ekhula esuka ku-{root}: lapho eqhelile kakhulu, yilapho ajoyine kamuva khona. Ngamunye ukhanya ngomsebenzi wakhe wakamuva (ama-commit kunoma iyiphi i-repository ye-HAX, izinkinga ezivuliwe nezivaliwe kuhlu lwezinkinga lwe-HAX), ashise kakhulu lapho ematasa bese efiphala ezinyangeni ezilandelayo.
peopleKey: Ukukhanya, kusuka ekuthuleni kuye ekushiseni okumhlophe
selectPerson: Khetha umuntu ukuze ubone ukuthi wajoyina nini nokuthi wenzeni.
agentsText: Ama-commit abhalwe ngama-ejenti e-AI, esebenza kuma-repository e-HAX nabantu abawaqhubayo, kusukela ngo-{date}. Abalwa ndawonye lapha, hhayi njengabantu.
chartHint: Esikalini se-log, ukukhuphuka okuqondile kusho ukuphindaphindeka okuzinzile, futhi ukugoba kuye phezulu kusho ukuthi kuyashesha.
rateThemes: Izingqikithi ezintsha ezingu-{n} ezinyangeni ezingu-12 kuze kube ngu-{date}: cishe eyodwa njalo ezinsukwini ezingu-{days}.
rate30: Izingqikithi ezintsha ezingu-{n} ezinsukwini ezingu-30 ezedlule.
noThemes: Azikho izingqikithi ezintsha ezinyangeni ezingu-12 kuze kube ngu-{date}.
preCore: Lezi zingqikithi zokuqala zandulela umongo wezingqikithi owabelwanayo, ofika ngo-{date}; yonke ingqikithi lapha kamuva yakhiwa phezu kwawo.
coreText: Yonke ingqikithi ilayisha umongo ofanayo owabelwanayo: u-{core} ocindezelwe nge-gzip kumafayela angu-{files}. Ingqikithi evamile yengeza u-{own} wayo, cishe u-{pct}% womongo. Ama-hexagon adwetshwe ngalesi sikali.
themeCost: Ukuvakashela okokuqala kusayithi ye-{name} kulayisha u-{first}. Ngemuva kokuthi isivakashi sibone isayithi ye-clean-one kumsingathi ofanayo, idinga u-{after} kuphela okwengeziwe.
twoLayers: Yakhiwe phezu kwe-{base}, ngakho isebenzisa kabusha izingqimba ezimbili.
newEls: Amaphakheji amasha angu-{n} ezinyangeni ezingu-12 kuze kube ngu-{date}.
elText: Amaphakheji asetshenziswa kakhulu ahlala phakathi nendawo; konke okuwazungezile kwakhiwe phezu kwawo. Asetshenziswa kakhulu ngo-{date}: {top}. Angu-{ddd} kulawa maphakheji angu-{n} akhiwe phezu kwe-DDD. Usayizi we-hexagon yifayela eliyinhloko lephakheji ngalinye, elicindezelwe nge-gzip; uhlaka lwegolide luphawula amaphakheji asetshenziswa amanye angu-20 noma ngaphezulu.
selectElement: Khetha isakhi ukuze ubone ukuthi sincike kuphi (okusawolintshi) nokuthi yini esisebenzisayo (okuluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka).
platText: Zonke zisebenza ngefomethi eyodwa yesayithi, i-site.json: ezinye ziqhuba amasayithi, ezinye ziyawakha noma ziwahlele, futhi i-PRAW igcina imithetho yayo.
platKey: Enemibala: izindawo ezisebhayini yenethiwekhi ye-HAX, ngemibala yazo yenethiwekhi. Empunga: izinkundla eziqhuba futhi zakhe i-HAX. Usayizi ukhula ngama-commit kuze kube manje; indandatho iyashaya ngama-commit enyanga ngayinye.
selectPlat: Khetha eyodwa ukuze ubone ukuthi ingeyani.
siteIntro: Isivakashi sifunda amakhasi ambalwa esayithi eyodwa ye-HAX, bese siya kusayithi elandelayo kumsingathi ofanayo. Phakathi kwamakhasi esayithi kulandwa kuphela izakhi ezengezwa yilelo khasi.
themeIntro: Isivakashi sivula isayithi ye-HAX eyodwa ngemuva kwenye kumsingathi ofanayo, ngayinye inengqikithi ehlukile, ngokulandelana kokwenziwa kwezingqikithi.
firstStep: Ikhasi lokuqala le-HAX kumsingathi lilanda konke: u-{need} kumafayela angu-{files}.
laterStep: Lesi sinyathelo sidinga u-{need}; u-{cached} wakho usevele ugcinwe kwinqolobane, ngakho silanda u-{fetch} kuphela.
unbundled: HAX: amafayela angahlanganisiwe, agcinwa kwinqolobane ngefayela ngalinye
cacheKey: Amaseli awolintshi ayalandwa manje, awegolide abesevele egcinwe kwinqolobane. Amaseli anohlaka angumongo owabelwanayo.
sources: Izinsuku: lapho ifayela ngalinye livela khona endleleni yalo yamanje, ne-commit yokuqala ye-repository ngayinye. Amabhayithi: i-gzip yomthombo wefayela ngalinye, ifayela ngefayela, kungafakwanga ikhodi yabantu besithathu. Iziphequluli zigcina inqolobane eyodwa kusayithi ngayinye, ngakho ukonga phakathi kwamasayithi kusebenza kumsingathi ofanayo.
drawing: {view} ngo-{date}: kuboniswe {n}. Iphaneli eseceleni kwayo ibala izibalo ezifanayo.
slowed: Ukudlala kunciphiswe izikhathi ezingu-30 enyangeni yokugcina
